title: Even Stream
prompt: Implement evens(limit) as a generator function yielding even numbers from 0 up to and including limit (if it is even).

tests.name: odd limit stops below
tests.hint: 9 itself is not even — exclude it.

tests.name: is lazy (a generator)
tests.code:
g = evens(100)
import types
assert isinstance(g, types.GeneratorType)
tests.hint: Use yield — the function must return a generator, not a list.
